Andhra Pradesh Government Announces Welfare and Development Initiatives

The Andhra Pradesh government has announced several initiatives aimed at improving the lives of contract health staff, rural infrastructure, artisans, and overall literacy. Contract health workers will receive significant relief, though specific details were not provided in the coverage. The state plans to invest Rs 50 crore to renovate 105 rural ponds. Additionally, 770 artisans will undergo training in new handicraft techniques. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu has set a target of achieving 100 percent literacy in Andhra Pradesh by 2027. The government has also agreed to the 12th Pay Revision Commission (PRC) for state employees, with pending dearness allowances (DAs) to be addressed.
